name: sequences
notes: Tony's rule: every dating pick plays as a full scene (establishing, insert, reaction, exit). See research/sprint-0930/sequences/.
props.shot = the NEW art id the visual team builds (GAPS.md 'art to build'); until then the bg art draws as the fallback.
Patches inside one scene run from the highest slot down so earlier slots don't shift.
hungry 0 now jumps straight to seq-butter / seq-katsu; hungry 1-2 (feed lines) moved into those scenes.

beats.text: A tiny curry house. Warm yellow light. Spice in the air. Two seats, side by side.

beats.speaker: NANDA
beats.text: Side by side. Not across. Across is how strangers sit.
Close-up. Butter chicken lands. Orange and glossy. One naan, torn in two.

beats.speaker: NANDA
beats.text: Say ahh. No, I feed you first. Then you feed me. That's the rule.

beats.speaker: NANDA
beats.text: Mm! See? You're so good at making me happy. Keep going. Forever.

choices.react: Anything. I'll hold you to that. ♡
Nothing is just anything with me.

beats.text: She wipes your mouth with her thumb. Then she licks the thumb.
The bell over the door. Outside, the big crossing roars again.
A tiny curry house. Oil hisses in the back. Two seats, side by side.

beats.speaker: NANDA
beats.text: You sit on the inside. By the wall. So nobody bumps you. So nobody gets you.
Close-up. Katsu curry lands. The knife goes in. Crunch.

beats.speaker: NANDA
beats.text: Hear that crunch? Like a little bone. Ehehe. Kidding. Say ahh.

beats.speaker: NANDA
beats.text: Mm! See? You're so good at making me happy. Keep going. Forever.

choices.react: Anything. I'll hold you to that. ♡
Nothing is just anything with me.

beats.text: She eats slowly. She never looks at the plate. Only at you.
The bell over the door. Outside, the big crossing roars again.
The station. Noon light through the glass roof. A train sighs somewhere.
Close-up. The ticket gate. She taps her card. Then taps it again. For you.

beats.speaker: NANDA
beats.text: I loaded your card last week. You're welcome. Don't ask how.
The door chime plays. She holds your sleeve the whole song.

tamagoyaki.text: Close-up. The lid lifts. Tamagoyaki, rolled in gold layers.

umeboshi.text: Close-up. The lid lifts. One red umeboshi on white rice.

beats.text: She doesn't eat hers. She watches you chew.
Close-up. Her fingers lock between yours. Tight. Tighter.

beats.speaker: NANDA
beats.text: See? A perfect fit. Like a lock. Click. ♡
A sakura park. Blue sky. Petals fall like slow snow.
The shop door jingles shut. The bags cut into your fingers.

beats.speaker: NANDA
beats.text: Heavy? Good. Heavy means you can't run. Ehehe. Kidding. ♡
Close-up. Three cups in the basket. She strokes the third one.
Outside, the crossing bell starts again. She waits for it to stop.
The library. Cool air. So quiet you can hear pages turn.
Close-up. The book drops in the return slot. Thunk.

beats.speaker: NANDA
beats.text: Bye, book. You were a good hostage. ♡

choices.react: With naan! You know me so well. ♡
Crunchy! You chose. I'll pretend I did.
You don't eat? Then you watch me eat.

choices.text: Walk to the station… and nothing else

beats.text: Close-up. Rain on the umbrella. Her shoulder gets wet. Yours doesn't.

beats.speaker: NANDA
beats.text: I'm cold. I don't mind. Dry people don't leave.
Close-up. Her house key is already in her hand. Warm. Held since noon.

beats.speaker: NANDA
beats.text: I held it all day. So I'd be ready. For us.
The kitchen. Too clean. Three chairs. The kettle is already warm.
Close-up. She pours. The steam curls up like a finger.

beats.speaker: NANDA
beats.text: Blow on it. No, let me. …There. Now it has my breath in it.
Upstairs, the kettle clicks off. Her slippers stop moving.
Above you, footsteps. Slow. Counting. One, two, three.
Close-up. Your cup, empty. Hers, full. She never drank.
Wide. Her street at night. One window lit. It's yours now.
Wide. The café. Every table has two cups. Every cup has your name.
